title: Air Quality Observation Model
description: Air quality monitoring stations, their sampling points (one pollutant measured at a station) and the time-series observations they produce, as delivered by partners.

StationKind.description: Classification of a station by the dominant emission sources influencing it.

Pollutant.description: Pollutant (observed property) measured at a sampling point. Code from the EEA pollutant vocabulary.
Pollutant.$comment: extensible code list; known values in examples

ConcentrationUnit.description: Unit of measure of the observed values of a sampling point.
ConcentrationUnit.$comment: extensible code list; known values in examples

ObservationValidity.description: Validity flag of a single observation (EEA validity code list).

VerificationStatus.description: Verification status of a single observation (EEA verification code list).

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees, WGS 84 (EPSG:4326) assumed (A-005).

lon.description: Longitude in decimal degrees, WGS 84 (EPSG:4326) assumed (A-005).

altitude.description: Altitude of the station in metres above mean sea level (unit and datum assumed, A-005). Absent and nil both mean unknown (A-006).

ObservationCollection.description: A partner delivery: the exchange envelope that bundles stations with their sampling points and observations. It has no identity of its own in S1.

station.description: Stations reported in a delivery (S1 element 'station', 1..unbounded).

Station.description: A fixed monitoring station at which air quality is measured.

stationCode.description: Stable code of the station, unique across partners (assumed, A-001).

operator.description: Organisation operating the station (free text in S1).

stationType.description: Station classification by dominant emission source.

sampling.description: Sampling points of a station (S1 element 'sampling', 1..unbounded).

Station.$comment: C-007: The unit of a sampling point must be appropriate for its pollutant (e.g. CO in mg.m-3, others in ug.m-3).

SamplingPoint.description: The measurement of one pollutant at one station (instrument/inlet), in one unit, producing a time series of observations.

samplingPointId.description: Identifier of the sampling point. Taken from the xs:ID attribute 'id' in S1; assumed stable across deliveries (A-001, Q-001).

pollutant.description: Pollutant measured, code from the EEA pollutant vocabulary (e.g. NO2, PM10, O3).

unit.description: Unit of measure of all observation values of this sampling point.

observation.description: Observations of a sampling point (S1 element 'observation', 0..unbounded).

SamplingPoint.$comment: C-006: samplingPointId must be unique across all deliveries (not only within one XML document as xs:ID guarantees).

Observation.description: One aggregated measurement value of a sampling point for a time interval (normally one hour).

begin.description: Start of the measurement interval (inclusive). Must carry a time-zone offset (C-002).

end.description: End of the measurement interval (exclusive). Must carry a time-zone offset (C-002).

value.description: Measured value in the unit of the sampling point; nil when no value is available (C-004).

Observation.$comment: C-001: end must be after begin.; C-002: begin and end must include an explicit time-zone offset (S1 xs:dateTime allows local times without offset).; C-003: Within one sampling point, observation intervals must not overlap (in particular no two observations with the same begin).; C-004: If value is nil, validity must be a 'not valid' code (-1 or -99).; C-005: value must be a finite number (no NaN/INF, which xs:double allows but JSON cannot represent).
